CREATE TABLE "Gadget" (
	serial INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER, 
	timestamp DATETIME, 
	gadget_label VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	frame_kind INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	frame_serial INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	part_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	gadget_validated BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (serial), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version) REFERENCES version (serial)
)
table.name: Gadget

)
table.name: GadgetPart
